description: One call: create a curated home office setup gift wishlist and return shopUrl (share link) + ownerUrl. Preferred agent path: create a desk board and add ASINs / keywords / search queries in one call. Pass marketplace + locale + role + budgetBand. Returns id, editToken, ownerUrl, shopUrl. OpenAPI: agentCreateAndFill.

itemQueries.description: Each query is searched and added as a desk item

locale.description: User locale, e.g. en, sv, de, fr, es, en-US

marketplace.description: Amazon storefront domain or id for the end user, e.g. amazon.se, amazon.com, se, de. REQUIRED — pass the user's storefront; curated ASINs only produce /dp links when trusted for that marketplace.

name: create_and_fill
title: One-shot create and fill
